annotations.title: Make a 3D model from a description

description: Make a textured 3D model of one object from a text description, when there is no image. Paid — 10 credits for the internal reference picture plus the model price (30–60 credits, by quality): tell the user the price and get their OK first. Returns a task_id; get_task shows the model when it is ready (a few minutes).

concept_id.description: Returned when the picture was made but the model did not start: pass it to retry without paying for a new picture (no prompt needed)

prompt.description: What to make, 3–500 characters: one object, its shape, colours and materials, e.g. "a red ceramic teapot with a bamboo handle"

quality.description: Wandy version: ultra = Wandy 2 (default, best for most objects; 60 credits), quality = Wandy 1.1 (best for cars; 50 credits), fast = Wandy 1 (cheapest and fastest, less detail; 30 credits)

name: generate_from_text
title: Make a 3D model from a description
